source.title: Risk-standardized acute admission rates among patients with diabetes and heart failure
source.location: Results: crude national acute unplanned admission rate 41.4 per 100 person-years (diabetes cohort)
source.citation: Drye EE, et al. Med Care. Risk-standardized acute admission rates among patients with diabetes and heart failure.

population.enrollment_notes: Medicare FFS ≥65 with diabetes; ACO-context framing in source.

cohort.exclusion_notes: Planned admissions excluded in source (~12% of stays).

numerator.notes: Source outcome is unplanned acute admissions — not equivalent to all-cause IP claim presence. Rate execution counts IP claim rows as events.

conditioning.notes: Diabetes cohort stratum matching source diabetes cohort framing.

estimand.notes: Person-time acute unplanned admission rate among diabetes cohort.

analysis.notes: Crude national rate among diabetes cohort (not risk-standardized coefficient).

result.notes: Scouting magnitude from Phase 0 inventory; re-verify primary table before Phase 3 freeze.

assumptions: Not equivalent to MVP O1 (all-cause claim presence).

governance.rationale: Excluded in corpus v1: planned-admission rate unsupported on MVP schema.
